standard.summary: 智能 LR 衰减最多可触发的次数，超过后不再继续降低。默认 3。
standard.effect: 防止 LR 因反复平台期无限下降至接近 0。3 次 × 0.5 = LR 降至原来的 12.5%。
standard.whenToUse: 默认 3 适合大多数场景。长训练（>1000 步）可适当增加到 5。
standard.avoidWhen: 不建议设为 0（完全不降）或过大（LR 接近 0 后训练无效）。

standard_en.summary: How many times smart LR decay may fire before it stops lowering the rate any further. Default 3.
standard_en.effect: Keeps repeated plateaus from driving the LR down towards zero. Three times 0.5 leaves the LR at 12.5% of the original.
standard_en.whenToUse: The default 3 fits most cases. On a long run of over 1000 steps, 5 is reasonable.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not set it to 0 -- no decay at all -- and do not set it so high that the LR reaches near zero and training stops doing anything.

advanced.principle: 计数器在每次触发衰减时递增，达到 max_decays 后停止响应平台期信号。
advanced.tradeoffs: max_decays 与 lr_decay_factor 共同决定 LR 的最终下限。

advanced_en.principle: The counter increments on each decay trigger; after max_decays it stops responding to plateau signals.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: max_decays and lr_decay_factor together determine the final LR floor.
